title: cleanup: standardize P-256 vs P-384 constructor style in wp11_backend_soft.c
description: wp11_soft_key_new_ecc_p256() uses explicit if/free/return-NULL error handling on each wolfCrypt call. wp11_soft_key_new_ecc_p384() compacts the same logic into ternary chains. Both are correct but diverge in style, so a fix to one path must be manually mirrored to the other. Standardize on the verbose P-256 style (explicit if/free/return NULL per step) -- it is easier to review, easier to add assertions, and matches the pattern used everywhere else in the backend.
